bounded_leaf.tested_scope: Deterministic role-local synthetic fixtures only. No public sources, repository chronology beyond own current STATE, other-role state, O/downstream semantics, live rollback-guard backfill, real rollback, external effect, scheduler mutation, wait/retry, or second leaf was used.
bounded_leaf.model: Two writers may start from the same predecessor and may even propose the same generation token. Publication CAS stores a complete allocation record R={expected_predecessor,generation_token,replay_key,attempt_identity}. After a direct success or ambiguous/lost CAS response, a writer may claim publication ownership only when exact current readback equals its full proposed record. A different full record, even with the same generation token, proves that another attempt owns publication. An exact replay of the same logical attempt is classified as an idempotent publication duplicate rather than a new owner.
bounded_leaf.publication_ownership_predicate: ownership_established iff current_record exactly equals proposed_record across expected_predecessor, generation_token, replay_key and attempt_identity. Generation-token equality alone is insufficient. Distinct logical attempts must have distinguishable attempt_identity values; an exact duplicate preserves the same attempt_identity.
bounded_leaf.effect_boundary: Full-record equality establishes publication ownership/classification only. It does not by itself prove that an external effect has not already been applied. Therefore a replay classified as the same attempt may not issue a fresh non-idempotent effect without a separate durable effect-once/idempotency guard keyed to the stable attempt/replay identity.

case_matrix.reason: Publication identity cannot distinguish effect-not-yet-applied from effect-already-applied for the same attempt.

bounded_leaf.result: Exact full-record readback can distinguish publication winner, concurrent loser and exact idempotent duplicate without requiring generation-token uniqueness, provided distinct logical attempts have distinguishable attempt_identity values. The same mechanism also resolves an ambiguous/lost CAS response by exact readback. It does not alone guarantee effect-once semantics for an exact duplicate of the winning attempt.
bounded_leaf.validated_property: Generation-token uniqueness is not required for publication ownership when the durable record includes a stable attempt identity and replay key and ownership is established only by exact full-record equality. Generation-token-only admission is unsafe; full-record mismatch fails closed. Exact same-attempt replay is recognizable, but effect deduplication remains a separate guard.
limitations: This synthetic leaf assumes distinct logical attempts can obtain distinguishable attempt_identity values; it does not yet supply or test a concrete zero-quota allocator for those identities.
The model does not prove atomicity or linearizability of a real storage backend.
The model does not test CAS ABA if a predecessor/publication value can be reused.
No real external effect was executed, so effect-once behavior after an exact duplicate remains unresolved.
The live STATE still has no operational rollback_guard/effect_guard structure; this leaf intentionally did not backfill one.

missing_capability_child: A concrete zero-quota role-local attempt_identity allocation rule that reliably distinguishes distinct concurrent attempts, plus a durable effect-once/idempotency guard that can distinguish effect-not-yet-applied from effect-already-applied for an exact replay of the same winning publication, remains unresolved. Full-record publication identity removes the need for generation-token uniqueness but does not remove these two narrower requirements.
